Vines Quirk.name: Vines Quirk
Vines Quirk.description:
🌿 You have thorny vines for hair that grow and move under your control.

🌱 At the start you extend a few vine bundles about five meters, retrieve a small object, screen your upper body or loosely bind one adult away from face and airway.
📈 With training: branching captures, climbing supports, rescue slings, dense screens across a street.
⚠️ You control only your vine hair; blades and fire damage it, water and sunlight replace losses slowly, heavy loads strain your neck, and thorns scratch allies.
🔗 Canon Drawback, built in: Finite Fuel, as drought and low sunlight limit replacement growth.
🎬 Canon Quirk: Ibara Shiozaki's Vines. You are not related to her; people who know her Quirk notice the resemblance.
🎒 Starts with: Quirk fuel pack x5, Fuel belt

📈 Grants: Cooperativeness +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Stamina +10, Capture +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Vine Fringe Guard, Bunched Vine Lash
Vines Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects:
Scale: thorned vine hair, moved at will. Start: a few bundles reach about 5 m to shield the upper body, fetch small items, loosely catch one adult. Street cover, multi-binding need training, healthy growth.
Limits: regrows only with water and sun; stored growth serves indoors, not endlessly. Edges sever, fire burns. Own vines only; no plant control, flowers, pollen, healing, poison, remote sight. Must go around obstacles. Heavy pulls strain necks; thorns hit allies. Captures spare airways, faces.
Quirk Strain: light: fringe guard, lash; moderate: bind, climb, disarm, rescue sling; heavy: dense screen, several captures; severe: signature spread, street control, building-wide.
Drawback: built in, the canon Finite Fuel.
Canon: Ibara Shiozaki's Quirk; user is unrelated, no tie unless the story makes one; those who know it see the resemblance.
Type: Mutant.
Law: user answers for thorns, blocked routes; restraints, street vines need license or self-defense.
Look: thorns.
